profile.headline: Software Engineer at Modern Treasury
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced software engineer focused on building cloud-based web services through strong technical leadership, design, and implementation. I enjoy enabling technical growth through innovation and new technologies while delivering software that empowers customers.

My system administration background and technical curiosity have helped me to better understand the development, deployment, and operations aspects of shipping products

positions.title: Principal Platform Engineer
positions.description:
Building the internal platform that all of the Stitch Fix microservices are deployed to.

Using Ruby, Go, and Terraform to deploy to AWS.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Terraform · Go (Programming Language) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Ruby on Rails · REST APIs · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Develop, deploy, and provide regular updates to a custom user registration system in use by multiple organizations. The software is written with Ruby on Rails and deployed to Heroku.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead engineer on a project using Ruby on Rails with MongoDB.
* Responsible for leading a team of engineers to deliver a JEE based Scrum project management tool. The tool had both a Swing-based desktop client and a modern web-based interface.
